# Reverse String elements without altering bytes

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Array reversal changes element order only. The embedded NUL and UTF-8 bytes inside each String remain unchanged.

Array reversal changes element order only. The embedded NUL and UTF-8 bytes inside each String remain unchanged.
